readability.reason: Clear headings, terms usually explained on first use, honest hedging and validation questions for past periods. Pulled down by density of 'the texts say / Raman / Saravali / Braha' citations, the same chart facts restated in 5-10 sections, tone verdicts for the same dated windows that disagree between sections (Mars-Saturn especially), inverted 'Mars within Rahu' labels in the timeline, and missing tables (mahadashas, current transits) that the benchmark uses to keep the timeline scannable.
